ownership.scheduler_sdk: Public DTO, owner-scoped management service, Module/SaaS transport only.
ownership.scheduler: Owns durable plan storage, owner filters, revision CAS, tombstones, recovery and execution projection.
ownership.tools_sdk: Owns the seven strict model-facing schedule schemas without owner, target, Action, provider, connection or cron input.
ownership.tools: Maps bounded inputs to Scheduler SDK. It derives allowed Actions from the currently authorized catalog and imports no owner implementation.
ownership.agent: Composes current Identity, the Tools adapter and an injected Scheduler SDK service; conversation and product HTTP share the same adapter.
ownership.frontend: Edits the public plan projection and submits only current revision plus bounded mutable fields.

fixed_routing.background_task_actions: derived from current authorized non-task/non-schedule catalog

management_semantics.list_scope: owner + optional status + stable plan-id cursor
management_semantics.mutation_guard: owner + plan id + expected revision CAS
management_semantics.resume_projection: next recurring window anchored after mutation time
management_semantics.delete: Scheduler-owned deleted tombstone hidden from public get/list and projected disabled on recovery
management_semantics.delete_reconcile: always asks Scheduler; a missing record is not synthesized as a successful replay
